description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Replace weekly hours of the business, or of one staff member/room with resource_id. Existing bookings are kept. Use it for the regular weekly pattern; for a one-off day off or extra hours use owner_block_time. The hours sent replace all the old ones, so send the whole week.

business_id.description: Which business, when the owner runs several: business_id from owner_status. Leave out when there is only one.

hours.description: Local, 24-hour: [{"days":"mon-sat","open":"09:00","close":"18:00"}]; days also "daily", ["tue","thu"]; a break is two ranges

resource_id.description: Only this staff member, room or rental pool: an id from owner_get_schedule. Leave out for the whole business.

name: owner_set_schedule
title: Set working hours
